goal: Validate ten controlled article jobs before any merge, indexing, scheduling, or publication
policy: No article from this batch may be merged to main, added to the shared index/Sitemap, scheduled, or published until human review and explicit approval.
generation_mode: two controlled groups of five; one independent branch and PR per article
